# SYS010: sys-claim-without-evidence

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| since | 2.0.0 |

A claim above proof level L1 has no test evidence.

Fires when the evidence rows of a non-assumed claim at L2 or above are empty or none is a test unit. Test units are recognised by path and qualified name (no `test_items` query exists yet). Unresolved when the evidence is May only or hidden.

## Examples

### SYS010 sys-claim-without-evidence / A claim at L2 whose evidence is not a test fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; owns "tests/**"; }
claim bad { noflow a -> d; proof L2; evidence tests "src/lib.rs::run"; }
=== src/lib.rs
pub fn run() {}
=== tests/t.rs
#[test]
fn it_works() {}
```

### SYS010 sys-claim-without-evidence / A claim backed by a test unit is clean #2 (line 21) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; owns "tests/**"; }
claim good { noflow a -> d; proof L2; evidence tests "tests/t.rs"; }
=== src/lib.rs
pub fn run() {}
=== tests/t.rs
#[test]
fn it_works() {}
```
